notes:
- Excel export of every report: the same title and the same columns as your company's web page (hidden columns too), with the title in the first row
- Visit Report: the same columns and rows as the web page, the Sales Rep filter, invoice numbers, and Close Visit in the visit window
- Sales invoice: the same page as the web for companies on the new web view (fields, quantities, free items, totals), To Approve and refresh customer
- Purchase documents: the same page and buttons as the web; purchase invoice Export and Recalc
- Sales Order: Print with price prints the web's order page
- Route planning: add customers to a saved plan with the Edit right; renamed pages and new reports open without a new app version
